what_this_is: Private shot list for RI-VIS06 Protocol A only. Same setups, camera and seed as tools/visual/deck.json; the ONLY differences are (a) restricted to the two `character` setups, because RI-VIS09 §2 routes Protocol A to refs/modern/character_closeup/ and nothing else, and (b) capture at 1920x1080 so our side is native-resolution against native-resolution plates (RI-VIS06 §D forbids a resolution mismatch). Nothing in tools/visual/deck.json is edited.

times.why: low sun, long shadows, the shot that proves shadows exist
flat noon — the least forgiving light for flat materials
dusk — where a colour grade would show if there were one

setups.label: player — close-up
setups.why: MANDATORY. No build reaches 7.0 with capsule characters, and this is the frame that says so

setups.label: nearest NPC — close-up
setups.why: MANDATORY. NPCs are built by the same actor code as the player; if one is good and the other is not, that is a dressing bug worth knowing

the swing arc and the weapon trail

streamed-boundary pop, which only motion shows
the grade across a full day
